title: AI Assessments
summary: Technical, aptitude, cognitive and behavioral tests with automated evaluation.
headline: Test real ability, *not just resumes*
lede: A resume shows what candidates say they can do. TalentPool365 shows what they can actually do. Assess technical skills, aptitude, thinking ability and behavior in one place, and get scored results without manual checking.
sectionIntro: A resume shows what candidates say they can do. TalentPool365 shows what they can actually do. Assess technical skills, aptitude, thinking ability and behavior in one place, and get scored results without manual checking.

capabilities.title: Technical Assessments
capabilities.tagline: Verify skills with real, role-relevant tests.
capabilities.body: Test candidates on the skills your job actually needs. Choose from ready-made tests or build your own, and see how candidates perform in practice.
points: Coding, tools and domain-specific question banks
Custom assessments tailored to each role
Skill-level scoring, from beginner to expert
Auto-graded results available as soon as the test is submitted

capabilities.title: Aptitude Assessments
capabilities.tagline: Measure how quickly candidates can learn and perform.
capabilities.body: Aptitude tests show whether a candidate can handle the demands of the job, especially for fresher and high-volume hiring where work history says little.
points: Numerical, verbal and logical reasoning sections
Timed tests with randomized questions
Percentile scores to compare candidates fairly
Suitable for campus, entry-level and bulk hiring

capabilities.title: Cognitive Tests
capabilities.tagline: Understand how candidates think and solve problems.
capabilities.body: Cognitive tests evaluate problem-solving, attention to detail, memory and decision-making. These are strong indicators of how someone will handle new challenges.
points: Problem-solving and critical thinking exercises
Pattern recognition and analytical reasoning tasks
Time-based scoring to show speed and accuracy
Consistent tests for every candidate, so comparisons are fair

capabilities.title: Behavioral Analysis
capabilities.tagline: Find people who fit your team and culture.
capabilities.body: Skills get someone hired, but behavior decides whether they succeed. Our AI analyzes responses to assess work style, communication, teamwork and values.
points: Situational and personality-based questions
Insights into communication and collaboration style
Fit indicators for specific roles and team environments
Helps hiring managers prepare better interview questions

capabilities.title: Automated Evaluation
capabilities.tagline: Get scored results without the manual work.
capabilities.body: Every assessment is evaluated automatically and consistently. Recruiters get clear reports instead of spending hours reviewing answers.
points: Instant scoring and detailed candidate reports
Combined score across technical, cognitive and behavioral results
Integrity checks to support fair, honest testing
Results linked to each candidate’s profile and ranking

outcomes.label: automated grading on technical & cognitive tests
higher prediction accuracy for on-the-job success

closingCta.headline: Make every hiring decision with confidence.
closingCta.body: See how TalentPool365 assesses candidates faster and more fairly.
